script.thesis: What you meant to say sits in the empty seat until you tell them.

anchor_object.name: empty passenger seat
anchor_object.initial_state: still indented from someone who left
anchor_object.setting: parked car at evening, door open

script.monologue: Don't wait to speak later. You touch the empty seat. Although the path waits empty for them now. A coat still waits unused there now. You pause in the empty lobby. Because they left the seat cold now. You stand in the doorway. Don't wait. Tell them at the seat. You walk back to the seat anyway.
